title: Fufu de Manioc
description: Fufu de Manioc is a Democratic Republic of the Congo classic prepared with cassava flour, peanut sauce. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Uses commercially processed cassava flour, not untreated raw cassava; never replace it with improperly processed cassava.

steps.instruction: Bring water to a vigorous simmer before introducing commercially processed cassava flour; do not boil raw untreated cassava flour as a shortcut.
Gradually beat the processed cassava flour into boiling water and stir vigorously until a thick glossy paste forms.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
